title: Fig. 1 "Space Suits" G-3C vs G-4C and G-4C Overvisor Space Helmet photos
description: Two black-and-white photographs on a NASA document page (M-913-65-04, dated 6/1/65). Fig. 1, headed "SPACE SUITS", shows two suited figures labeled "G-3C" (with a portable unit) and "G-4C"; the lower photo, labeled "G-4C OVERVISOR SPACE HELMET", shows a man wearing the helmet with a reflective visor. Side text compares the old G3C suit with the new EVA G4C suit and visor light attenuation.
